title: Python shared parameter registry consistency checker

input_contract.fixture_or_inventory: Observed shared-parameter records must provide GUID where known plus name and data_type fields.
input_contract.unresolved_source_rows: Names present only in unresolved_entries are not treated as passing governed definitions.

execution_contract.method: Compare observed parameter identity and structural fields against the governed central Shared Parameter Registry.
execution_contract.matching_key: GUID is authoritative where present. Name is used only to detect unresolved source rows and conflicting identity claims.

required_observations: matched governed registry identity where available

result_mapping.pass: Every observed governed shared parameter matches an active central registry entry by GUID and required structural fields.
result_mapping.fail: An observed parameter uses an unknown GUID, conflicts with the governed name or data type for a known GUID, or asserts a governed identity that conflicts with the central registry.
result_mapping.not_applicable: The tested subject declares that no governed shared parameter requirement applies.
result_mapping.indeterminate: Required evidence is incomplete or an observed parameter corresponds only to a source row whose governed GUID remains unresolved.

provenance.migration_note: First repository-native executable conformance implementation. CI fixture verification covers governed pass, fail, and indeterminate cases against the migrated central Shared Parameter Registry. The ETS remains a migration candidate as a governed artifact even though its implementation behavior is fixture-verified.
